اکانت‌ها با ایمیل یا شناسهٔ اکانتشان در: Accounts are grouped by their email or their account id at Anthropic; an account connected by token only has no email, so name it once with the pencil. «Fresh» is tokens without cache reads; «with cache» is what the API and tools like ccusage count. Cost is at API list price (input, output, cache writes and cache reads each at their own rate; weight = output price relative to Sonnet). The plans are flat-rate, so cost is a scale to compare by, not a bill. Each install reports every 15 minutes from its own database; a report older than a day counts in no total or account.
